head: 2d975934279420c26a18e1cc3785063c9f1192dd
title: Float setter on Transaction writes the unrounded float product into the integer amount

bugs.note: The decimal amount is multiplied by the minor-unit factor as a float and assigned without rounding. 2556.72 * 100 is 255671.99999999997, so the int cast reads it back as 255671 and the column gets a value that depends on the database, which leaves the transaction and the recalculated balance a cent off.
